revision5_changes: Changed the facade procedural palette to source-photo-matched red-brown running-bond brick with subtle mortar relief; wall coordinates align courses to each facade orientation.
Removed 48 punched-window and mullion objects that fell inside the existing two-storey glazed atrium panel; retained adjacent facade windows.

Rebuilt the named GIS shell from its original eight corner coordinates with outward normals and cut a watertight two-storey atrium opening behind the glazing. Approximate opening: 22.25 m wide by 8.30 m high by 18.0 m deep; the depth is a visualization estimate, not an as-built measurement.
Moved the three schematic collaboration table groups and six seats behind the glazing, and increased atrium transparency to reveal interior cues.
Added a restrained semicircular entry arch, fanlight spokes, frame, and tinted door panels based on Purdue ECN photo. Dimensions and exact frame configuration are estimates, not surveyed.
Preserved the GIS footprint bounds, local origin, stable collection name, and master placement responsibility.
remaining_uncertainty: No surveyed elevations, as-built construction/room plans, or measured atrium depth were available.
The official exterior photo is not geotagged and its capture date is unpublished; page last modified is 2014-03-18.
Floor plans/interior vignettes remain schematic and are not as-built.
Roof monitor, precise heights, and exact window dimensions remain unverified.
